title: init-ci generator
description: Generates a GitHub Actions release workflow using the local @nx-devkit/release executors for OIDC trusted publishing.

projectName.description: Name of the workspace project that hosts the prepare-for-release target.

pluginPath.description: Module specifier for the plugin in nx.json plugins[]. Use a relative path or package name.

generateNotes.description: If true, create a GitHub Release with auto-generated changelog. Default: true.

provenance.description: If true, publish with --provenance (npm OIDC). Default: true.
